title: Trevor Paglen's book on black-project patches

tellings.quote: it basically what it is is a compilation of black project patches

plain: A writer named Trevor Paglen is said to have put together a book that is "basically a compilation of black project patches": the cloth badges worn by the teams on secret, highly classified military programmes, which are known as black projects. Matthew Brown, presented on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels about it without naming the book's title. He points to it as a way to see that hidden programmes leave visible traces, even when the programmes themselves are kept secret.
